audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits 51.72% over 1280 games: Irelia owns the levels where Distortion is on 15s, LeBlanc owns the level 6 window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was attributed to Mirror Image. Mirror Image is LeBlanc's PASSIVE — it triggers below 40% health from level 1. Her level 6 spike is Mimic (R), 45/35/25s.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: below 40% health she goes invisible 1s and spawns an 8s clone. Nothing about it is gated on level 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, spikes[1].text, mid, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1] now say Mimic, and the passive is described where it actually matters (chasing her below 40%).

audit.whatIsWrong: Ethereal Chains' 1.5-second shackle-before-root was never stated, nor that Sigil of Malice needs a second spell to detonate, nor that Flawless Duet's grounding denies Distortion.
audit.why: Those three are the whole exchange: break the chain in 1.5s and she has no lockdown; ground her and the return half of Distortion cannot save her.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid and breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: late and whys[6] credit Irelia with a 'W shield'. Defiant Dance grants reduced PHYSICAL damage taken while charging — no shield, and no help against LeBlanc's magic burst.
audit.why: LeBlanc deals magic damage; the reader would hold W expecting mitigation that does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] reads Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, LeBlanc, Irelia, Irelia.
audit.why: Packet levelChart matches the content layer exactly, so the full-layer side tokens were the stale ones.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to the content layer with ratings and whys rewritten in the same proposal; win[N] already matches so no content-layer chart edit is needed.

edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. It governs your forward steps. - W Defiant Dance spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Distortion is 15s at rank 1 and the return half only lasts 4 seconds — step up the moment that window closes. - Sigil of Malice is a flat 6s and needs a second spell to detonate it. - Ethereal Chains roots only after 1.5s shackled, so break the 925 range and it never lands.

edits.before: First item onward, the wave is a weapon: crash it into all-ins, R the disengage, and surf the side-lane resets between objectives.
edits.after: Her burst needs Sigil detonated by a second spell — eat the Q, charge W through the follow-up, then E-stun before her 4s return opens.

edits.before: If LeBlanc takes first blood, tighten up: Distortion is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q resets and stay relevant through stacked windows.
edits.after: If LeBlanc takes first blood, respect both halves of Distortion: out and back means she pokes from safety — farm with Bladesurge resets and step up only once she has already blinked home.

edits.before: Carry through the dance — the wave funds dives no cooldown can, and your R turns skirmishes into no-exit interviews.
edits.after: Carry through the dance — Flawless Duet grounds Distortion, and Vanguard's Edge walls the lane she wants to blink home through.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 continue to favor Irelia because Bladesurge closes the gap faster than LeBlanc can kite, and her Distortion blink on a long cooldown early means a well-timed engage often can't be answered.
